sourceRefs.locator: Historic excavation photograph CfO0176, C55000/1, 1904. Norwegian caption identifies foreman Aksel Stubstad, engineers Glende and Beck, and preparator Paul Johannesen. File record credits Olaf Væring and documents CC BY-SA 4.0.

labels.en: The excavation team beside the Oseberg ship, 1904

alt.de: Hinter dem freigelegten Holzrumpf stehen die Männer des Grabungsteams vor der steilen Erdwand. Rechts am Bildrand steht der Präparator Paul Johannesen.
alt.en: The excavation crew stand above the exposed wooden hull against a steep wall of earth. The museum preparator Paul Johannesen is at the far right.
